head: 5143fbdc4bdadf907f59c433e81ab11b2e98c6dc
randomness: Preserve Torch CPU/CUDA RNG around adapter construction/setup so model input dimensionality cannot perturb simulation random streams; runtime reset and policy greedy controls otherwise unchanged
source_policy: No production edits; official extended adapter loads native 6/9-dimensional checkpoints without conversion; common observed-information production executors and unchanged physical rules

metric.primary: 1 - sum(candidate completed joint mission seconds)/sum(rule completed joint mission seconds)
metric.aggregation: 12 equally weighted paired cases; no dropping failures or selecting groups
metric.completion: All nonrelay tasks complete AND actual radio>=0.9 AND Safety fully released, continuously for3s; full300s physical window must remain safe
metric.failure: Any candidate or baseline incomplete/unsafe case fails acceptance eligibility; report censored300s separately, never exclude it
metric.secondary: sum(rule time)/sum(candidate time)-1, Search sensor Find latency; neither replaces primary
metric.groups: Report30-static,30-dynamic,60-static,60-dynamic and per-seed results; no subgroup regression required
metric.confidence: Seed-cluster bootstrap percentile95%, descriptive only with3 independent seeds; point-estimate gate is predeclared, not proof lower confidence bound>=15%

pass_rule: All24 full H300 runs valid, all12 pairs jointly complete and safe; pooled primary>=0.15; each four domain-group primary>=0.0
scope: Unseen seeds on unchanged connected80m scenario. Does not establish original500m deployment/map generalization.
no_adaptation: One frozen round8 only. Do not tune/retrain/select another checkpoint after viewing reserved outcomes. Preserve partial attempts; infrastructure retry only explicitly labelled.
